branding.description: Prionex helps companies manage overdue debt faster and more efficiently. Full automation, clear analytics, and tools to improve results.

logout.title: Sign Out
logout.message: Are you sure you want to sign out?

accountLocked.title: Account Locked
accountLocked.message: Your account is locked due to too many failed attempts.
accountLocked.autoUnlock: It will be unlocked automatically in {{minutes}} minutes.
accountLocked.contact: Contact your Admin if you need immediate access.

alreadyLoggedIn.title: Already Logged In
alreadyLoggedIn.message: You are already logged in on another device.

ipNotAllowed.title: Login Not Allowed From This Network
ipNotAllowed.message: Login from this IP address is not permitted for your account.
ipNotAllowed.contact: Ask your administrator to add this IP to your login whitelist.

changePassword.title: Change Your Password
changePassword.subtitle: Your password must be changed before continuing

validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app
twoFactor.subtitleBackup: Enter one of your backup recovery codes

errors.codeFormat: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app

section.title: Two-Factor Authentication
section.description: Protect your account with Google Authenticator

setup.title: Enable Two-Factor Authentication
setup.qrInstructions: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator (or any TOTP app). If you can't scan, enter the secret manually.
setup.verifyInstructions: Enter the 6-digit code your authenticator app shows now to confirm setup.
setup.backupIntro: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator.
setup.acknowledge: I have saved my backup codes in a safe place.

errors.cannotStart: Could not start setup. Please try again.
errors.mustSaveCodes: Confirm that you've saved the backup codes before closing.

disable.title: Disable Two-Factor Authentication
disable.warning:
Disabling 2FA makes your account easier to compromise.
To confirm, enter your password and a current authenticator code.

errors.backupAlreadyUsedHint: If you've already used this backup code, it cannot be used again — try a different one from your saved list.

regenerate.title: Regenerate backup codes
regenerate.intro: Generate a fresh batch of backup codes. Your existing codes will stop working immediately.
regenerate.successIntro: Your new backup codes are ready. Save them now — old codes no longer work.
regenerate.invalidatesOld: Save these now. Your previous backup codes have been invalidated.

backupCodes.warning: These codes are shown only once. Store them in a password manager or print them.

section.title: Sign-in through the mobile app
section.description: Bind your phone to your account. A bound phone can sign in to Prionex Hub from any network, without the IP address restriction. Every other sign-in check (account status, project and role, two-factor authentication) still applies.
section.toggle: Allow sign-in through the mobile app
section.descriptionNoBypass: Bind your phone to your account to sign in to Prionex Hub with it. On this server sign-in from the phone still follows the IP address restriction. Every other sign-in check (account status, project and role, two-factor authentication) applies as usual.

enable.title: Confirm it's you
enable.intro: To bind a phone, enter your CRM password.
enable.submit: Get a code for the phone

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.impersonation: A phone cannot be bound or unbound while viewing as another user.
errors.failed: Could not get a code. Please try again.

disable.title: Turn off sign-in through the app?
disable.warning: All phones will be unbound. Enter your password to confirm.
disable.success: Sign-in through the app is off, phones unbound
disable.failed: Could not turn off sign-in through the app

pairing.instructions: Open Prionex Hub on the phone: Settings → Security → "Bind this phone" — and enter the code.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code for binding the phone
pairing.qrHint: Or point the phone camera at the QR code
pairing.openOnPhone: Open in Prionex Hub (if this page is open on the phone)
pairing.expiredHint: Get a new code and enter it in Prionex Hub.

devices.title: Bound phones
devices.unbindMessage: Phone "{{label}}" will no longer be able to sign in without the IP address restriction. Its mobile session will be ended.
devices.limitReached: The maximum number of phones is bound ({{max}}). Unbind one to add a new one.
